variant: coating version (putty and emulsion paint spraying)
name: BMR Intelligent Coating Robot P65
summary: Indoor robot that sprays wall putty (100 m²/h) and emulsion paint (250 m²/h) on walls and ceilings up to 6.5 m without pre-scanning.

germany.statusNote: No authorised route to Germany found. BMR sells direct from China and names markets in Asia, the Middle East and Brazil, none in the EU. The only German listing is a US reseller not named by BMR, and BMR states no CE marking for this machine. Roboter Deutschland, a web shop run from Las Vegas without a named company, also lists it; it is not counted as a seller here.

sellers.name: Shenzhen BrightMaster Robotics Co., Ltd.
sellers.note: Direct export enquiries via form, email or WhatsApp from Shenzhen; no EU office or EU distributor named.

specs.label: Software
specs.value: RTPC real-time perception; one-click start, no pre-scanning or path planning

notes: One platform with different modules: P45/P65 spray putty and emulsion paint, M40/M60 sand putty.
P65 is 1630 x 1150 mm in plan; check door and lift sizes.
Crosses at most 30 mm steps and 50 mm gaps, slopes up to 10°.
Maker advises manual touch-up where needed and a material test for new coatings.

images.alt: BMR Intelligent Coating Robot on a construction floor (banner with text; model not labelled)

evidence.task: Putty and emulsion paint spraying on walls, ceilings and bay windows in residential, office, school and hospital buildings

openQuestions: Is this machine CE-marked and does it come with an EU declaration of conformity? BMR states CE only for its Measuring Robot.
Does BMR have, or plan, an authorised distributor or service partner in the EU or Germany?
Is Roboter Deutschland / Robots International authorised by BMR, and who provides service and spare parts in Germany?
Can one chassis be switched between P and M modules, or is each model a separate machine?
The page lists three coverage rates (above 95 %, 85 %, 90 %) for four models; which applies to this model?
